evidence: The temperature was ramped up to 335 °C to deposit ~ 20-nm-thick AlN and AlGaN layers using trimethylaluminum (TMA), TEG, and NH3 as precursors. TMA and TEG were carried by vapor-draw, while NH3 was allowed to flow at a rate of 60 sccm. The ALD reaction for AlN (GaN) film proceeded according to the following steps: TMA (TEG) feed, N2 purge, NH3 feed, and N2 purge.
